checks.coherent_sector: Each +++ port is a permutation, so sitewise equality of all48 triples makes every channel input equal to the spatial six-neighbor sum; forward equality is preserved.
checks.dispersion: Substitution gives cos(omega)=alpha*(sum_j cos(k_j))/3. Baseline small-k squared coefficient1/3; at fixedalpha<1 it is alpha*acos(alpha)/(3*sqrt(1-alpha^2)).
checks.forced_solution: With zero initial mismatch, e(T)=sum_s U_(T-1-s)(alpha B) epsilon(s)/N. T=1 and recurrence induction fix the indices.
checks.gapped_bound: For alpha<1, spectral support lies in[-alpha,alpha], so |sin(theta)|>=sqrt(1-alpha^2), giving norm U_n<=1/sqrt(1-alpha^2).
checks.initial_rounding: Homogeneous error is U_T(alpha B) delta_b0-U_(T-1)(alpha B) delta_a0. Each initial RMS<=1/(2N), hence(2T+1)/(2N).
checks.operator_bound: B=A/6 is self-adjoint with spectrum in[-1,1] on the periodic RMS space. For alpha<=1, norm U_n(alpha B)<=n+1. Sum gives eta*T*(T+1)/(2N).
checks.remainder_error: r difference is at most M-g within a fixed modg sector, giving eta=1-g/M. This is a deterministic retained-state term.
checks.unstable_example: Uniform p2/q1 gives u6b, quotient4b and unchanged remainder exactly, hence b_next=4b-a.

scope_limits: Other p/q values are a separate unimplemented candidate.
The estimate is finite-time RMS, not pointwise with the same constant.
Frequency gap is not physical mass.
Small normalized field error does not control raw threshold-event timing.
Robustness outside the coherent48-channel sector is untested.
